title.title: ZIM title
title.description: Title of the ZIM (at most 30 characters)

description.title: ZIM description
description.description: Description of the ZIM (at most 80 characters)

long_description.title: ZIM long description
long_description.description: Long description of the ZIM (at most 4000 characters)

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: Name of content creator. Default: OpenStreetMap contributors

file_name.title: ZIM filename
file_name.description: ZIM file name, without .zim; {name} and {period} (YYYY-MM) are replaced. Default: {name}_{period}

tags.title: ZIM tags
tags.description: Semicolon (;) delimited list of tags to add to the ZIM

illustration_url.title: Illustration URL
illustration_url.description: URL (or path) of a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG (SVG needs zimscraperlib, as in the Docker image) used for the ZIM illustration. Default: a generated map icon

output.title: Output
output.description: Output folder for the ZIM. Default: ./output

stats_filename.title: Stats filename
stats_filename.description: Path to store the progress JSON file to

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Keep temporary files (the build log is always verbose)

area.title: Preset area
area.description: A preset area from create_osm_zim.py's KNOWN_AREAS, e.g. monaco

include_poly.title: Include poly
include_poly.description: URL of a .poly file bounding the area. A Geofabrik URL also selects its OSM extract; otherwise give --pbf-url

bbox.title: Bounding box
bbox.description: minlon,minlat,maxlon,maxlat. For an area across the antimeridian, minlon > maxlon (Fiji: 172.8,-23.2,-176.5,-11.2)

pbf_url.title: OSM extract URL
pbf_url.description: OSM extract (.osm.pbf) to build from. Default: the Geofabrik extract of --area / --include-poly

no_routing.title: No routing
no_routing.description: Leave out offline routing (on by default)

terrain.title: Terrain
terrain.description: Hillshade from Copernicus DEM (downloads DEM tiles)

max_zoom.title: Max zoom
max_zoom.description: Maximum zoom of the vector tiles. Default: 14

zim_workers.title: ZIM workers
zim_workers.description: Compression threads for libzim. Default: the CPU count, at most 20

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Feature set: full: Wikidata, Wikipedia articles, Overture Maps; basic: none of them (routing is on in both). Default: full

wikidata.title: Wikidata
wikidata.description: Wikidata place details (needs network access to Wikidata). Default: on with --profile full, off with basic

wikipedia.title: Wikipedia articles
wikipedia.description: English Wikipedia articles for the places that have one, stored in the ZIM (CC BY-SA). Text from the Wikipedia API, or text and images from --wikipedia-zim-url. Default: on with --profile full, off with basic

overture.title: Overture Maps
overture.description: Overture Maps addresses and place details (websites, phones, brands, categories), read from Overture's public S3 bucket over HTTPS. Default: on with --profile full, off with basic

wikipedia_zim_url.title: Wikipedia ZIM URL
wikipedia_zim_url.description: Kiwix Wikipedia ZIM (download.kiwix.org) to read the articles and their images from instead of the API. Downloaded for every task: a full English one is 50 to 120 GB. Default: none (the API, text only)

wikipedia_images.title: Wikipedia images
wikipedia_images.description: With --wikipedia-zim-url: the articles' images to store (lead: the first picture). Default: all

overture_release.title: Overture release
overture_release.description: Overture release, e.g. 2026-09-23.1. Default: latest (the newest complete release)
